HeadSubject: ## Managed Cryptographic Foundation I — SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256, and Secure Entropy

Architecture.Sha256: Owned incremental managed SHA-256; fixed 64-byte block and 64-word schedule.
Architecture.HmacSha256: Owned incremental HMAC-SHA256 over ManagedSha256; 64-byte block, long-key preprocessing.
Architecture.Entropy: Direct bounded hardware fill; RDSEED preferred per word, RDRAND fallback; no DRBG.
Architecture.TestProvider: Explicit injected deterministic provider exists only in the host test project.

Payload.BCryptProvenance: NativeAOT runtime/PAL random-byte import retained in the payload; repository dependency census identifies it as fail-fast and unreached. Phase 25 uses the native CPUID/RDSEED/RDRAND boundary instead.
